✓ Zakir Husain (governor).fact: Zakir Husain was appointed Governor of East Pakistan on 10 October 1958. He took oath of office on 11 October and continued as Governor till 14 April 1960, During his governorship which spanned over nearly one and half years, he tried his best to make Basic Democracy popular in East Pakistan and worked hard in the February 1960 elections for President Ayub Khan.

✓ Zakir Husain (governor).question: He returned to _____ in 1964, and retired from active politics
✓ Zakir Husain (governor).fact: He returned to Chittagong in 1964, and retired from active politics. Among others, he initiated the building of the 500-bed Chittagong Medical College Hospital, Chittagong University, Chittagong Women's College, Chittagong New Market, and the establishment of Rangunia College from a school.
